title: A SURVEY OF AESTHETIC AND FUNCTIONAL ELEMENTS IN ETULO ORALLITERATURE
text: This essay is a survey of oral performances among the Etulo people found in Buruku and Katsina-Ala Local Government Areas of Benue State. It is the product of a field trip which studied three major Etulo festivals, some of their folk narratives and their common songs and recitations, both secular and spiritual.
